detail.title: Micky Ergonomic Mouse Pad with Wrist Rest Support
detail.overview: The Ant Micky Mouse Pad combines a smooth tracking surface with built-in wrist rest support, giving the hand a natural resting position through long work or gaming sessions. Soft foam cushioning under the wrist reduces fatigue and strain, while the premium top surface ensures accurate, responsive tracking for both optical and wireless mice. A strong non-slip base keeps the pad firmly anchored on the desk, preventing slips or shifts during use, and its eco-friendly, non-toxic materials wipe clean easily to stay hygienic. Compatible with any laptop or desktop setup, it's a comfortable everyday choice for office, home or gaming desks.
